propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs in the default suite reached 99% progress and then froze for 1.7–4.3 hours until manual cancellation, affecting runs omitting commit 96a0d5c3f which lack bounded blob prefetch during partial-clone checkout.
The _build-and-test.yml reusable workflow test job lacks a timeout-minutes declaration, defaulting to GitHub's 360-minute limit and allowing stuck workers to block queued runs indefinitely.

Gerrit changes 1129 PS1-3 introduced a regression in test_jira_dc_transport.py where FakeJiraClient.search_issues ignored startAt/maxResults pagination parameters, causing test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract to loop indefinitely and timeout.

The per-blob lazy-fetch hang is contained by commit 96a0d5c3f (merged on main) and the pagination regression is fixed by slicing FakeJiraClient results by offset; both defects must be present for the symptom.
Adding timeout-minutes: 60 to jobs.test in _build-and-test.yml bounds the job execution and prevents manual-clear dependence, while the pagination fix eliminates the hang mechanism itself.
